headline: Margin headwinds temporary; structural upside intact

highlights: Increasing strategic importance of the India entity within the global parent, expansion of its product portfolio through recent acquisition (safety components) and JVs (for e-axles and electronically controlled air systems) and a sharper focus on localisation could help accelerate its growth trajectory.
These factors position BOS for a structurally stronger growth and profitability trajectory reinforcing our positive investment thesis.
We raise FY27-29E revenue by 2% but cut FY27/28E EBITDA by ~2% as pass-through of inflationary costs could be gradual.
Q2FY27 result: Revenue ahead; margins below estimate BOS’s consolidated revenue of INR 76.5bn (+28% YoY/+7% QoQ) was 6% above our estimate.
valuation: Further, it expects production for its JV with TSF Group to commence by the end of FY28. • BOS is in discussion with multiple PV OEMs in India for supplying its hybrid technology.
Its parent is an established player in hybrid systems and supplies to multiple global OEMs.
The views and opinions expressed in this document may or may not match or may be contrary with the views, estimates, rating, and target price of the Retail Research.
watch: Demand and margin outlook Management expects underlying industry growth across auto segments to moderate in H2, owing to a high base.
The recipient should independently evaluate the investment risks.
